name: Screen Record (macOS)
summary: Record your Mac screen to an MP4 file. Pick the display, set a bitrate, and start.
description: Captures the entire screen via AVFoundation (the native macOS capture API), encodes with H.264 + AAC, and writes a self-contained MP4. Use the screen index variable to pick which display to record on multi-monitor setups (0 is the primary display). The output bitrate is configurable; defaults to 6 Mbps which is fine for documentation / demo recordings.
